_meta.note: Local demonstration content. Never generated into production store configuration. Consumed only by tools/serve_daybreak_demo.py (localhost preview) and tools/build_black_friday_demo.py (static /demo/black-friday/ bundle). The 72-hour demonstration window is computed at serve/page-load time; no deadline is authored here.

name.es: Vista Previa del Evento de Black Friday

disclosure.en: BLACK FRIDAY DEMO — Illustrative offers only. These are not current Lacks promotions. Ask your Lacks specialist about actual offers.
disclosure.es: DEMOSTRACIÓN DE BLACK FRIDAY — Estas ofertas son solo ilustrativas. No son promociones vigentes de Lacks. Consulta con tu especialista de Lacks sobre las ofertas reales.

headline.en: Qualifying mattresses include a Black Friday sleep bonus through the displayed deadline.
headline.es: Los colchones que califican incluyen un bono de descanso de Black Friday hasta la fecha límite indicada.

detail.en: Your specialist confirms eligibility and explains the available bonus before checkout.
detail.es: Tu especialista confirma la elegibilidad y explica el bono disponible antes de finalizar la compra.

headline.en: Demo only: choose two cooling pillows or a mattress protector with a qualifying mattress.
headline.es: Solo demostración: elige dos almohadas frescas o un protector con un colchón que califique.

detail.en: One illustrative bonus choice per qualifying mattress purchase.
detail.es: Una opción de bono ilustrativo por cada compra de colchón que califique.
